Here is the LinkedIn post:

Hook:
Project 1 of the AI Builder Journey focused on building a RAG Knowledge Assistant for answering questions using approved documents.

Body:
I worked with the RAG flow of documents, chunks, embeddings, vector store, retrieval, LLM, and answer generation. This project connected retrieval with generation, enabling an AI application to use relevant information from provided documents when answering questions.

Lesson:
RAG connects retrieval with generation, allowing an AI application to use relevant information from provided documents when answering questions.

CTA:
Learn the basic RAG workflow and understand how retrieval supports an AI answer.

Hashtags:
#AI #Python #RAG #KnowledgeAssistant #AIBuilderJourney

Here is the LinkedIn post:

Hook:
When working on Project 1, I learned the importance of trustworthy answers in RAG Grounding and Source Checking.

Body:
A RAG system should use retrieved information as context and avoid presenting unsupported information as if it came from the supplied documents. This ensures that answers are reliable and accurate. 

Lesson:
A key takeaway is that a RAG system should use retrieved context and not present unsupported information as if it came from the provided documents.

CTA:
Try a small RAG project and test both answerable and unanswerable questions.

Hashtags:
#RAG #SourceChecking #AIApplications #BeginnerFriendly

Here is the LinkedIn post:

Hook:
Designing an AI-assisted lead qualification system in Python.

Body:
I worked on a project that focused on designing an AI-assisted lead qualification system in Python. The system involved lead input, classification, structured output, recommended next actions, and reply drafting. The key takeaway is that an AI application becomes more useful when model output is connected to structured data and clear application logic.

Lesson:
Structured AI output can be used inside a Python application.

CTA:
Explore how structured AI output can be used inside a Python application.

Hashtags:
#AI #Python #LeadQualification #StructuredData
